title: studio: autosave validates normal intermediate states — switching a field to Picklist, picking Lookup or adding a Notify node shows a red error before the author can fill it in
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio: choosing *Selection · Picklist* as a field's type produces a red banner before the options editor can be used; same for Lookup before a target is picked and for a freshly added Notify node (`PUT …/meta/flow/<name>?mode=draft` → 422).

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

Autosave fires on every intermediate state and its refusal is shown as an error, so the normal path (pick a type → then fill it in) always passes through a red banner. The banner clears only after the author completes the field.

## Expected

Incomplete-but-normal states are hinted inline ("Add at least one option", "Pick the object to link to") and held as an unsent local draft; errors are reserved for states the author has finished.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Validate client-side first; when the shape is incomplete, skip the network save and show an inline hint on the inspector field; block only at publish.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *intermediate state validation picklist no options lookup no reference notify title autosave error*: 5 hits (0 open, 5 closed).
- Related, not the same defect:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11253 (closed) — closed 2026-10-01 (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11287): added the write guard that HOLDS the option-less select save; this card's red error on switching to Picklist is plausibly that guard's refusal surfaced as an error -- direct follow-up
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#3094 (closed) — premature lookup-reference message, different surface
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: autosave intermediate state error · picklist no options banner · lookup reference banner · notify node 422 draft
